const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { jest } = require('@jest/globals');
jest.mock('./util');
const util = require('./util');

test('no assertion at all', () => {
  util.run();
});

test('only a constant truth', () => {
  assert.ok(true);
});

it('compares a value with itself', () => {
  const x = util.run();
  expect(x).toBe(x);
});

test.skip('skipped', () => {
  assert.equal(util.run(), 1);
});

test.todo('later');
